tools.name: get_mineral_prices
tools.description: Fetch normalized real-time spot prices, bid/ask spreads, and multi-unit conversions for critical physical commodities: Neodymium/Dysprosium (NdDy), Lithium (Li), Copper (Cu), Silver (Ag), Platinum (Pt). Free tier sandbox trial available. Requires 0.005 USDC on Polygon via x402.

mineral_type.description: Specific critical mineral symbol or name preset (default: 'Neodymium')

tools.name: get_arbitrage_spreads
tools.description: Calculate cross-exchange price spreads and locational arbitrage opportunities between COMEX, LME, SMM, and LPPM benchmarks, factoring in freight and tariffs. Free tier sandbox trial available. Requires 0.005 USDC on Polygon via x402.

tools.name: calculate_urban_mining_value
tools.description: Evaluate contained minerals, process recovery efficiencies tensor, and net settlement value (USDC) after refining charges (TC/RC) for urban mining scrap feedstocks (E-Waste PCBs, EV Battery Black Mass, Auto Catalysts, Rare Earth Magnets). Free tier sandbox trial available. Requires 0.005 USDC on Polygon via x402.

scrap_category.description: Feedstock category of the recyclable scrap batch (default: 'E_WASTE_HIGH_GRADE_PCB')

quantity_metric_tons.description: Total batch weight in metric tons (default: 1.0)

custom_assay_overrides.description: Optional custom assay grades to override standard defaults (e.g. {'Au': 250} in ppm or {'Li': 4.5} in %)

refining_cost_per_ton_usd.description: Optional custom refining & treatment charge per ton in USD

recovery_efficiency_factor.description: Recovery efficiency multiplier (1.0 = standard benchmark recovery)

tools.name: get_onchain_signed_feed
tools.description: Generate an EIP-712 cryptographically signed price feed payload and raw ABI calldata (v, r, s) to update or consume price data directly in Solidity smart contracts on Polygon (Chain ID 137 / Amoy). Requires 0.005 USDC on Polygon via x402.
